meta.name: Basement Company
meta.description:
The show is set in Gurgaon, where first jobbers Raj, Simran and Rahul are forced into the basement of the office PunjaBeats as the small start-up undergoes a major transformation to attract more business. These three badnaseeb buddies are put in the wackiest situations as they try to regain their territory upstairs. While trying to achieve this, they are fighting their respective battles to achieve their dreams which lie beyond the four walls of this company as well as juggling friendships, relationships and their new lives at work.

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5

videos.title: Silver Lining
videos.overview: Working in the basement was a challenge in itself, but now Simran, Rahul and Raj had to grapple with an additional hurdle of water leakage.

videos.title: Password Incorrect
videos.overview: All three of them were trying every trick in the book to impress their Boss. While Rahul prepares a speech for a special guest, Simran tries to find the favourite cake of her Boss. But plans don't always play out the way we want them to.

videos.title: Ticket For Two
videos.overview: The opportunity for which Simran, Rahul and Raj were looking everywhere, came knocking on their door, but not without a twist.

videos.title: I Quit
videos.overview: The desperation to move out of the basement and find a place of their choice brings Simran, Raj and Rahul to the point of a fallout. Battling with loneliness and disappointment, the three of them think about leaving their job.

videos.title: Back In The Day
videos.overview: Simran, Raj and Rahul wish to put aside all their differences and bitterness and get back together again. Will they be able to become friends again?
